initial_compile_result.failure: Each source_review.json lacked the required top-level review_material field.

repair.operation: Copy the already-frozen review_material object from the corresponding source_review_request.json into source_review.json.

outcome_separation: The reviewer performed only the schema repair and did not run case compilation or inspect construction results before freezing the repaired reviews.
artifact_interpretation: Per-paper construction/failure.json files preserve the first failed compile attempt. Later construction/result.json files are the authoritative post-repair dispositions and are used by summary.json.
